title: Exception to performance of duties by senior-most member
description: Performance of duties by senior-most member in absence of President

content.general_rule: The senior-most member of the National Commission performs the duties of the President in his absence
content.exception: Unless a retired Judge of a High Court or a person who has been a Judicial Member is a member of the National Commission, in which case such member shall preside
conditions: the person is a retired Judge of a High Court or a person who has been a Judicial Member
the person is a member of the National Commission

user_queries: Who presides over the National Commission in the absence of the President?
